findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors / よくあるエラー
findings.proposition: The English tells the reader to select the 32-bit version of R from inside RStudio via Tools/Global Options (confirmed by the next bullet, which says to re-install R with a different bit version). The Japanese says to try 32-bit RStudio and that Tools/Global Options lets you switch to 32-bit RStudio ('32-bit 版の RStudio を試してみてください。RStudio の Tools/Global Options から 32-bit 版の R Studioに切り替えることができます。'), which is a different program and is contradicted by the Japanese line 94 itself, which places the setting under R Sessions / R version.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader searches Tools/Global Options for a way to switch RStudio's own bitness, finds none (RStudio has no such setting), and may go looking for a 32-bit RStudio download instead of switching the R version, so the documented fix for 'internet routines cannot be loaded' is never applied.

findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors / よくあるエラー
findings.proposition: The English places 'This PC' in the right hand pane of the Windows file manager ('right click on "This PC" on the right hand pane'). The Japanese places it in the left pane ('左パネルにある「PC」を右クリックし').
findings.reader_consequence: The two versions of the handbook give opposite locations for the same click target, so a reader comparing them, or an editor reconciling them, cannot tell which pane is meant; only one of the two step descriptions can match the interface the reader sees.

findings.heading: Troubleshooting common errors / よくあるエラー
findings.proposition: The Japanese names a specific menu path for where the 32-bit option appears, 'Tools/Global Options の R Sessions/R version'. The English says only 'if 32-bit version does not appear in menu', naming no submenu.
findings.reader_consequence: The reader is sent to a named submenu that the English source never states, so if that submenu name is wrong or has changed in the reader's RStudio version, the reader concludes the option is absent and wrongly diagnoses their RStudio as v1.2.
